samples.content:

import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    A = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    A.sort()
    median = A[n // 2]
    sys.stdout.write(str(median))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
